description: A named scholar and practitioner of forbidden magics who opened a rift to the abyssal planes, after which demons invaded Golarion and Sarkoris became the Worldwound.

power_traditions.note: Exact official description; no full spell list, school, or rule mechanics are inferred.

cosmologies_and_realms.note: The official premise says Areelu opened a rift to these planes.
The official premise identifies the world invaded after the rift opened.
The campaign overview identifies the transformation of the realm after the invasion.

metaphysical_laws_and_rituals.note: The event is presented in the campaign premise; its unlisted process, motive, and consequences are not expanded.

canon_status: Named individual directly described in the official Enhanced Edition campaign premise.

supports: Areelu Vorlesh's name, scholar/forbidden-magics description, rift, demonic invasion, Golarion, Sarkoris, and Worldwound premise

comparison_cautions: 'Forbidden magics' and the rift are retained as source-native campaign terms rather than mapped to a generic class or external occult tradition.
The official overview does not support unlisted species, alignment, personal motive, relationship, defeat, romance, or ending claims.
